full_prompt_en: A square dynamic anime illustration shows a young street fighter standing on a mound of broken urban rubble against a fierce orange sunset and smoky damaged buildings. The viewpoint is low, looking up toward the central figure, so the legs and oversized boots carry much of the foreground. The sky behind moves from hot yellow near the horizon to dusky teal above, filled with rolling purple-brown smoke clouds. Leaning building facades frame both sides, their windows and rooflines jagged and partly lost in the glow. The blond-haired youth stands near the center, looking slightly down and left with a determined expression. A brimmed cap sits over wind-tossed hair. A short dark vest and layered shirt cover the torso, while a long scarf or open fabric strip trails from the shoulder. Wide brown knee-length shorts, wrist bands, and thick high-top boots emphasize the streetwear silhouette. One hand hangs at the side near a dark rounded accessory. The figure plants one boot higher on a broken beam or stone, creating a strong triangular stance above the debris. Small colorful creature-like figures are scattered around the lower left and lower right, including a blue form near the front, but they remain secondary to the larger human silhouette. Thin dark structural poles and rubble fragments point toward the center. Intense warm backlight from the horizon outlines the youth, boots, smoke, and shattered buildings, while the front planes hold cooler blue-black shadow. Painterly flame-colored clouds contrast with crisp character outlines and textured wreckage. No readable text appears. The overall composition is defiant and energetic, using low-angle scale, blazing warm light, and crowded diagonal ruin to make one standing figure the clear focal point.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动感动漫插画呈现一位年轻街头战士站在破碎城市瓦砾堆上，背后是炽橙落日、浓烟与受损建筑。视点从低处向中央人物仰望，因此双腿和夸张厚靴占据前景大部。背后的天空从地平线附近炽黄转向上方昏暗青蓝，滚动的紫褐烟云充满其间。倾斜的建筑立面从两侧框入，窗户与屋顶线条锯齿状，并部分消失在光辉中。金发青年站在中央附近，以坚决神情略向左下看。有檐帽压在被风吹动的头发上。短深色背心与层叠衬衣覆盖上身，一条长围巾或敞开的布带从肩旁飘出。宽大的棕色及膝短裤、护腕和厚重高帮靴强调街头服饰剪影。一只手垂在身旁，靠近一件深色圆形配件。一只靴子踏在更高的断梁或石块上，让身姿在碎物之上构成有力三角形。小小的彩色生物状形体散在左下与右下，包括前方的一道蓝色形体，但它们都次于较大的人物剪影。细暗结构杆和瓦砾碎片指向中央。地平线的强暖色逆光镶亮青年、靴子、烟和破败建筑，正面色面则保留较冷蓝黑阴影。绘画式火焰色云层对照清晰角色轮廓与有肌理的废墟。没有可读文字。整体构图反叛而充满能量，用低角度尺度、燃烧般暖光和密集斜向残垣，让一位站立人物成为明确焦点。
style_prompt_en: The action-oriented anime style combines a crisp central silhouette with rough painterly environmental energy. A blazing yellow-orange core illuminates rust, violet smoke, and teal upper shadow, giving the palette a sharp warm-cool split. Strong low-angle perspective enlarges the nearest vertical forms, while leaning side masses and scattered diagonal fragments drive attention inward. Dark ink-like contours preserve character readability amid dense brushy detail. Rim light trims exposed edges; front surfaces remain deep and cool, so the brightest area sits behind rather than on the central mass. Layered haze separates near debris from distant structures without erasing their angular rhythms. Small saturated accents distribute motion around the lower edge but do not displace the main focal figure. The overall effect is rebellious, theatrical, and kinetic, with graphic pose design supported by a storm of textured color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动作感动漫画风把清晰的中央剪影与粗犷绘画式环境能量结合。炽烈黄橙核心照亮锈色、紫烟和青蓝上部暗影，使配色呈现鲜明冷暖分裂。强烈低角度透视放大最近的竖向形体，两侧倾斜大形与散落的斜向碎片把注意力推向内部。深色墨线般轮廓在密集刷笔细节中保持主体可读。轮廓光修饰暴露边缘，正面表面仍深而偏冷，使最亮区域位于中央大形后方，而非其表面。层叠雾气分开近处碎块与远处构造，同时不抹掉棱角节奏。少量饱和重音沿下缘分布运动感，却不取代主要焦点。整体效果反叛、戏剧化且富动势，图形化姿态设计受到色彩肌理风暴的支撑。
theme_en: A young street fighter standing on rubble against a burning sunset city
theme_zh: 年轻街头战士立于瓦砾上，背后是燃烧般的落日城市
name: The World Ends With You
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
